boundary.zh: 智谱开放平台供应商级 API 产品面；GLM 型号、模态与单个能力页不拆分为集合。
boundary.en: The supplier-level Zhipu Open Platform API surface; GLM model variants, modalities, and individual capability pages are not split into collections.

blockers.zh: 官方流式消息采用 SSE，知识库 Agent 等能力还定义专用 SSE 事件；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: Official streaming messages use SSE, and knowledge-base agent capabilities define additional SSE events; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 待 SSE 支持后盘点模型、知识库、文件、异步任务和区域边界。
nextAction.en: After SSE support lands, inventory model, knowledge-base, file, asynchronous-task, and regional boundaries.
